image_title: Tool Verification for Test-Time Reinforcement Learning
summary: This visual presents the process of Tool Verification for Test-Time Reinforcement Learning (TRL), illustrating how an LLM verifier parses sampled outputs and examines their validity. The verifier integrates with a code interpreter to validate each output, yielding a verification weight for each rollout. The diagram shows the interaction between the verifier, tool, and pseudo-label generation, emphasizing the importance of majority voting for deriving consensus outputs. It highlights the challenge of spurious rewards in self-evolving AI systems and proposes a verification approach to ensure reliable learning without explicit supervision. The visual includes references to the methodology and implications for reinforcement learning in uncertain environments.
